Code and reproducible analyses for function adaptive shrinkage (FASH).

## Data

- [iPSC dynamic eQTL summary statistics (Zenodo)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23989707):
  effect estimates and $t$-adjusted standard errors for all 1,009,173
  gene-variant pairs (6,362 genes) across 16 differentiation days.
